limitations.detail: Only visibility and viewport browser capabilities are advertised; no documented real browser zoom control. 200% variants blocked, not emulated by width.
No documented network offline/throttling/interception capability. Offline cache and weather timeout/error/late success manual variants blocked.
IAB CSS viewport test only; physical phone, touch, DPR2, orientation sensor and on-screen keyboard are unavailable.

Browser execution ended at the RU wizard first question. The action selecting Coffee and Continue did not return a verifiable state because the CUA call timed out. On continuation, parent confirmed all QA servers and browser state were reset. No saved-answer wizard history/reload/result sequence, smart-choice pair edit/language cancellation, short-height orientation, quick-builder keyboard purchase or rapid-photo sequence is claimed. Fresh-tab RU #step-3 safe recovery at 320×740 is the only saved SITE-005 subvariant.

Only explicit records establish coverage. RU menu searched all three tea names; EN/TR interfaces searched their own tea name, and EN320 keyboard searched Black Tea. All three queries on each EN/TR interface and a complete keyboard clear sequence were not executed. Home navigation and Discover handoffs were exercised in TR at 1280 and390; EN/RU home/Discover layout and shared language checks do not establish their full handoff scenarios. Both quick paths plus ordinary reload were verified nonempty in EN; every empty/nonempty × route × language combination was not executed. Long-name dialog and full language-cycle variants remain partial.

GUEST-004 mouse Close, Escape, backdrop and return focus were verified on desktop, with a separate EN320 keyboard tea sequence. Touch and844×390 landscape were not executed. SITE-003 history/unknown routes were verified at1440;320×740 was not repeated. SITE-014 measured all four guest surfaces at390 forEN/RU and TR home/menu/quick/Discover, plus selected RU320 menu/Discover/quick states; full320 home traversal, pair add/cart edit, staff/counter and all locale interactions were not completed by this worker. SITE-016 completed EN320 menu keyboard search/open/cancel/add/remove plus RU desktop modal traversal; allTR/RU first/last-item paths and200% zoom remain unverified.

Only UI repeat visits and ordinary reload were observed through SITE-004. The documented browser surface exposes no network request/response inspection or service-worker controls. ETag/304/no-store and old-SW/new-build public-cache behavior were not manually verified. A source or HTTP contract check is separate evidence, not a browser pass.

Saved records include exact RU empty-cart GUEST-001 tea50/latte180 at actual1440×900,390×844 and320×640, and GUEST-003 unknown-search/clear/tea50 with empty cart at desktop1440×900 andmobile320×640. All browser dimensions are CSS IAB viewport measurements, not physical-device tests.

The historical failed Turkish skip-link record is retained. After parent rebuilt the correction, RU andEN menu/Discover were separately verified with visible keyboard focus at320×740. This establishes the specific localization fix, not full completion of every SITE-009/SITE-016 variant.
